item.title: Gross GST collections rise 14.7% to ₹2.04 lakh crore in September
item.description: Gross GST collections rose 14.7% to ₹2.04 lakh crore in September. GST on imports rose 25.9% while domestic GST grew 10.1%.

item.title: Rupee slips to 96 per dollar as FPIs sell ₹35,861 crore in September
item.description: The rupee weakened to 96 against the US dollar. Foreign portfolio investors sold ₹35,861 crore of equities in September as US yields rose.
